heard: This planet is darker than asphalt and glows red. Discovered in 2008, the hot Jupiter known as WASP-B whips around its star in roughly 26 hours. The exoplanet orbits just 2 million miles from its host, locking one side in permanent day. Enormous tidal forces have stretched this swollen world into a distorted egg shape. Dayside temperatures soar to over 4,600 degrees Fahrenheit, thermalizing the atmosphere so no clouds can form. Hubble observations revealed that its superheated gas is actively spilling onto the star. Tidal friction is draining its orbital energy, shrinking its year by milliseconds annually. Locked in an irreversible death spiral, this pitch-black world has only about 3 million years left.
